mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supportive environment for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and INDPRO increases during economic expansion.
